name: hermes-browser-runtime
description: Standalone Hermes browser runtime: drives a real, locally-installed Chromium via puppeteer-core (Chrome DevTools Protocol) to perform real Instagram lead discovery on behalf of one Business Badhao organization's own dedicated, manually-authenticated Instagram account. Runs outside Vercel, on a separate, always-available machine you provision and operate yourself. Never a cloud browser service, never Playwright, never TinyFish.
